keys.beat: He plucks the string and it sings like a swallow; Zeus answers with thunder.
keys.text: He took it in his right hand to prove the string, and it sang sweetly under his touch like the twittering of a swallow. The suitors were dismayed, and turned colour as they heard it; at that moment, moreover, Jove thundered loudly as a sign.

keys.beat: Telemachus places sword and spear beside him and moves to his father's side.
keys.text: Then Telemachus girded on his sword, grasped his spear, and stood armed beside his father's seat.

keys.beat: He tells Telemachus that the stranger has not disgraced the house and signals the next phase.
keys.text: 'Telemachus, the stranger within your house has not disgraced you. I did not miss what I aimed at... Now, however, it is time for the Achaeans to prepare supper while there is still daylight.' As he spoke he made a sign with his eyebrows.
